policies.description: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields before invoking the register_configuration_item tool.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: Only users with the Administrator or Agent role are allowed to create (register) a configuration item, because they have full CRUD permissions on the configuration_item (CMDB) table.
references: Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables.
Agent (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | Full CRUD on Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge.

policies.description: Every configuration item must have a recorded owner_id field.
references: CI Owner: All CIs must have a recorded owner_id.

policies.description: The status supplied for a new configuration item must be one of the enumerated values: in_use, in_stock, maintenance, retired, or disposed.

policies.policy_name: CI Must Be Stored in Configuration_Item Table
policies.description: All configuration items (IT assets) must be recorded in the configuration_item table.
references: Table: All IT assets must be recorded in the configuration_item table.
